page_title: BOL 2-0 LEC | Bologna v Lecce 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' 2 - 0 Goal! Federico Bernardeschi tees up Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the left side of the goal. 2:0.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Alex Sala (Lecce) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
85' Substitution. Santiago Castro (Bologna) did his best and is replaced by Jens Odgaard.
85' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) replacing Nikola Moro.
83' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Santiago Pierotti and he is replaced by Alex Sala (Lecce).
83' The Santiago Castro (Bologna) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Andrea Colombo rules it out for a foul.
81' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
79' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
79' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' The corner is swung in and Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the left post from close in.
77' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) steps up to send the ball in.
74' Substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) will be replaced by Jonathan Rowe.
74' Here is a change. Simon Sohm (Bologna) is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Tommaso Pobega.
74' Lecce fail to score from a corner as Massimo Pessina (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.

74' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Good work from Lecce as they win a corner.
73' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

71' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
66' Juan Miranda (Bologna) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
66' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Joao Mario will be replaced by Nadir Zortea (Bologna).
66' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Remo Freuler (Bologna) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
64' The substitution is prepared. Konan Ndri joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lameck Banda (Lecce).
64' Here comes a substitution. Nikola Stulic (Lecce) is given a rest as he is replaced by Walid Cheddira.
63' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
62' Santiago Castro (Bologna) commits a foul and Andrea Colombo immediately signals a free kick.
62' The resulting corner, taken by Nikola Moro (Bologna), comes to nothing.
59' Nikola Moro (Bologna) takes the corner but it's cleared.
59' Juan Miranda (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
55' Santiago Castro (Bologna) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
53' The resulting corner from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
52' Nikola Moro (Bologna) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
51' Simon Sohm (Bologna) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Colombo saw the whole situation.
49' Nikola Moro (Bologna) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
46' Half-time substitution. Oumar Ngom (Lecce) will not participate anymore and Omri Gandelman is coming on.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco has made a change at the break. Antonino Gallo has come on in place of Corrie Ndaba (Lecce).
46' The whistle blows and Andrea Colombo starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
44' Lecce are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Bologna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
42' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
38' Jamil Siebert (Lecce) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
38' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' Joao Mario (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Now Bologna have a corner.
37' Bologna have been awarded an indirect mid-range free kick.
36' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
34' Lameck Banda (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
33' Bologna are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' 1 - 0 Remo Freuler (Bologna) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 1:0.
26' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.
22' Bologna showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
18' Corrie Ndaba (Lecce) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
16' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Wladimiro Falcone.
14' Lecce keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
11' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
9' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Massimo Pessina acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!

7' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
2' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
